# AgentHive Inc

> AgentHive Inc embeds working AI in real operations, then leaves it running. First Deploy is the product. Consulting is how you buy time in the room. Grok writes The Buzz every week and ranks the live apps.

AgentHive Inc is a Palm Coast, Florida studio. Daniel Graham embeds working AI in real operations, then leaves it running. Proof: live apps in field ops and a public Netlify portfolio.

## This site
- [AgentHive Inc](https://agenthiveinc.com/): Flagship hive. Grok Bots, First Deploy, and the live portfolio.
- [The Buzz](https://agenthiveinc.com/buzz): Weekly AI and infrastructure briefing compiled by Grok.
- [Rankings](https://agenthiveinc.com/rankings): Live listing and ranking of every public AgentHive app, including the Netlify portfolio.
- [About](https://agenthiveinc.com/about): Who we are and what we sell.
- [Custom Builds](https://agenthiveinc.com/build): First Deploy embeds. Live this week or you do not pay setup.

## Company
- [First Deploy](https://firstdeploy.ai/): After-hours desk and live apps for field operators. $1,500 setup, then $250/month.
- [Consult](https://firstdeploy.ai/consult): Free 30-minute qualifier, then $75 / 30 min, $150 / hour, or a 10-hour pack at $1,250.
- [ClaudeFarm](https://claudefarm.com/): Public storefront for First Deploy, consult time, and the live AgentHive apps.
